notes: Alpha.13 restores the official DSH Web surface as the baseline. Home now keeps one WebView alive across native bottom-tab switches, so returning to Home does not reconstruct or reload the DSH SPA. The experimental dsh-client-ui-mobile package is retained only as a dormant APK-owned asset and is removed from the active Web profile because its narrow-screen CSS hid official DSH sidebar/header/settings UI. Existing alpha.12 profiles migrate offline while preserving user fields and the mobile-context integration. Robolectric, ARM64 Runtime E2E, lint, clean Android build, and stable signing verification pass; OriginOS visual/device validation remains manual.
